_comment: Self-contained SDXL text-to-image keyframe workflow (ComfyUI API format). Used for BOTH scene base images AND shots without a character, so it MUST NOT require a reference image. Placeholders injected by the pipeline: {{POS_PROMPT}} {{NEG_PROMPT}} {{SEED}} {{WIDTH}} {{HEIGHT}}. REQUIRED MODELS: checkpoints/sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors (swap for any SDXL checkpoint). All nodes are ComfyUI core (no custom nodes). For character consistency (reference-face injection via IPAdapter) use the sibling file keyframe_sdxl_ipadapter_api.json and point config/pipeline.yaml workflows.keyframe at it.
